entities.name: Alaborn
entities.description: Militaristic, egalitarian human nation of the southern plains of Caliman on Dominaria that used firearms.

entities.name: Trokin
entities.description: Capital of Alaborn, famous for its festival.

entities.name: Tojira
entities.description: Swamp queen whom Alaborn's forces battled before the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion after which Alaborn's survival is unknown.

entities.name: Goblin tribes
entities.description: Mountain tribes that inflicted humiliating defeats on Alaborn.

events.summary: Alaborn's forces met the goblin tribes of the mountains and suffered humiliating defeats, saved only by ingenious military inventions.
Shortly before the Phyrexian Invasion, Alaborn's forces battled the swamp queen Tojira.
events.quote: the forces of Alaborn battled the swamp queen Tojira
